title: Interview Anne van Grevenstein
descriptions: This interview with conservator of paintings, polychrome sculpture and historical interiors Anne van Grevenstein was initially conducted for the FAIC Oral History program (USA) founded by Joyce Hill Stoner. Anne van Grevenstein was already interviewed for the FAIC Oral History program in 2009 by Muriel Verbeeck. The 2009 interview focused more on the training of Van Grevenstein. The 2017 interview can be seen as a follow up and covers her work at the Jan van Eyck Academy (Maastricht), the Central Laboratory (Amsterdam), the Frans Hals Museum (Haarlem), the SRAL (Maastricht), of which she was director, and her professorship in Nijmegen and Amsterdam. Projects like the Oranjezaal and MolArt are also discussed.
